content.short: Found is a US banking app for freelancers and the self-employed with built-in tax and invoicing tools.
content.description: Found is a US banking app built specifically for freelancers, contractors and self-employed workers who need to manage business finances and taxes together. Its account combines business banking and a debit card with automatic expense tracking, invoicing and tax tools that estimate quarterly taxes, set aside money for the IRS and help with write-offs and filing. By tying banking directly to bookkeeping and taxes, Found removes much of the manual admin solo business owners face, letting them see real-time profit, categorize expenses and avoid tax-time surprises. It targets the growing gig and self-employed economy with an alternative to using separate bank, accounting and tax products.
content.meta: Found is a US banking, tax and invoicing app for freelancers and the self-employed. Discover Found and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
